description: This PHP source file defines the Customer report model class for OpenCart, providing methods to retrieve various customer-related statistics and data, such as total customers by day, week, month, year, customer details, orders, reward points, activities, and searches.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Model class for customer reports, providing methods to gather customer statistics and data for reporting purposes.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByDay
methods.description: Returns an array of total customers grouped by each hour of the current day.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByWeek
methods.description: Returns an array of total customers grouped by each day of the current week.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByMonth
methods.description: Returns an array of total customers grouped by each day of the current month.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByYear
methods.description: Returns an array of total customers grouped by each month of the current year.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves customer records based on optional filters such as date range, group, start, and limit.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer records based on optional filters.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves order data associated with customers, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of customer orders based on filters.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Retrieves reward points data for customers, with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalRewardPoints
methods.description: Returns the total count of reward point records based on filters.

methods.name: getCustomerActivities
methods.description: Retrieves customer activity logs with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerActivities
methods.description: Returns the total number of customer activity records based on filters.

methods.name: getCustomerSearches
methods.description: Retrieves customer search records with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerSearches
methods.description: Returns the total number of customer search records based on filters.
